title: MRR ResearchDecision
description: docs/spec/08_RESEARCH_METHOD_KERNEL.md (status ACCEPTED, 2026-07-21) section 3's object table ('ResearchDecision | adaptive decision record: continue, revise, narrow_scope, kill_branch, replicate, escalate_human_review, stop_insufficient_evidence | issued (append-only)'). Sixth and final of the six task-packets/K1-T01.yaml entities. 'decision_type' is the exact seven-value closed vocabulary, nothing added or dropped. MRR-MTH-011 ('stop_insufficient_evidence decisions are successful terminal results ... MUST NOT be silently omitted') is satisfied at the contract level by validating stop_insufficient_evidence IDENTICALLY to every other decision_type value — no extra required field, no distinguishing flag. 'status' is a single-value const ('issued') — append-only, no lifecycle transitions (see mrr.domain.lifecycles.RESEARCH_DECISION_LIFECYCLE, declared with one state and zero legal transitions). 'rationale' is this task's own minimal addition (not itself named by spec 08's one-line table entry) — a decision record with no recorded reasoning would be an audit dead end; flagged as an open specification point.

decision_type.description: The exact seven spec 08 section 3 values, verbatim.

protocol_id.description: The governing MethodProtocol this decision was made under. A plain body field, never an edge; not validated to resolve to a real MethodProtocol here (service-level, deferred).

applies_to_analysis.description: A free-string tag matching one entry of the governing MethodProtocol's own planned_analyses list, mirroring MethodRuling.applies_to_analysis's identical shape. No first-class 'branch' object exists in this repository; this cross-object correspondence is not validated here.

rationale.description: The reasoning behind this decision. This task's own minimal addition (not itself named by spec 08's one-line table entry) — every decision_type value requires it identically, so this does not reintroduce the per-type special-casing MRR-MTH-011 warns against.

status.description: Append-only: the only value that has ever existed for this kind (spec 08 section 3: 'issued (append-only)').
